cards.card_text: Speaking a second time, the voice tells Peter not to call anything impure that God has made ___.
cards.verse_text: The voice spoke to him a second time: “Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.”
cards.snippet: The voice spoke to him a second time: “Do not call anything impure that God has made clean.”

cards.card_text: Nothing impure has ever entered his mouth He has been fasting since early that morning He has never killed an animal himself
cards.verse_text: ‘No, Lord,’ I said, ‘for nothing impure or unclean has ever entered my mouth.’
cards.snippet: ‘No, Lord,’ I said, ‘for nothing impure or unclean has ever entered my mouth.’

cards.card_text: Paul says an immoral, impure or greedy person still has an inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
cards.verse_text: For of this you can be sure: No immoral, impure, or greedy person (that is, an idolater) has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God.
